name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
summary: A free cooking gas connection for women in poor households, with the first refill and a stove included.
benefit_note: ₹2,050 towards a 14.2kg connection, or ₹1,300 for a 5kg connection. Covers the deposit, regulator, hose, consumer card and installation. The first refill and a stove are free.
how_to_apply: Choose a gas company — Indian Oil, Bharat Gas or HP Gas — and open its Ujjwala application page.
Fill in the KYC form and the deprivation declaration.
Give your Aadhaar, address proof, ration card and bank account details.
Your nearest distributor verifies the application and issues the connection.

Benefit, eligibility and the documents list were taken from https://www.pmuy.gov.in/ on 2026-08-09. Every source_quote is wording from that page.

THIS IS UJJWALA 2.0. The old scheme listed qualifying household categories — SC/ST, AAY, PMAY, tea garden, forest dweller, islands. Those are NOT the current criteria. 2.0 is three things: an adult woman, no existing LPG connection in the household, and a deprivation declaration. Do not re-add the category list from an older source.
